{"text":"今回は、東洋と西洋が出会う国、トルコへの旅にご案内します。","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/ADMIN/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/6740439840254333443/92988aefce8a45c8fd7fe58a60fc72cc/特黑体-思源黑体1号.otf","id":"6740439840254333443"},"strokes":[{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}},"width":0.0805491954088211,"mode":0}],"size":7,"bold":true,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,29]}]}

material.content: {"text":"ミナレットが近代的な都市のスカイラインにそびえ立ち、そこに生きる女性たちが伝統と現代的な魅力の神秘的な調和を体現する場所。","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/ADMIN/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/6740439840254333443/92988aefce8a45c8fd7fe58a60fc72cc/特黑体-思源黑体1号.otf","id":"6740439840254333443"},"strokes":[{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}},"width":0.0805491954088211,"mode":0}],"size":7,"bold":true,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,61]}]}

material.content: {"text":"さあ、一緒にその秘密を解き明かしていきましょう。","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/ADMIN/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/6740439840254333443/92988aefce8a45c8fd7fe58a60fc72cc/特黑体-思源黑体1号.otf","id":"6740439840254333443"},"strokes":[{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}},"width":0.0805491954088211,"mode":0}],"size":7,"bold":true,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,24]}]}
